cues.en: Besides us making our own tools, it is also possible to consume MCP tools.
cues.zh: 除了自行建立工具，也可以使用 MCP 工具。

cues.en: MCP, or Model Context Protocol, you might have heard of.
cues.zh: 你可能聽過 MCP，也就是 Model Context Protocol，模型上下文協定。

cues.en: If you haven't, it's a protocol where others can expose their code, their actions, their information,
cues.zh: 如果還沒聽過，它是一種讓其他人公開程式碼、動作與資訊，

cues.en: and you to consume, so you don't need to use their APIs.
cues.zh: 供你使用的協定，因此不必直接整合各自的 API。

cues.en: A good example is GitHub, where if you use your GitHub MCP, it can list issues, create branches, and stuff like that.
cues.zh: GitHub 就是很好的例子，透過 GitHub MCP，可以列出 Issue、建立分支等等。

cues.en: In our case, we are going to use the Microsoft Learn MCP server.
cues.zh: 這個範例會使用 Microsoft Learn MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: So they show that they have an MCP server.
cues.zh: 可以看到他們提供了一個 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: There are two types of MCP servers.
cues.zh: MCP 伺服器分成兩種類型，

cues.en: There are remote MCP servers and local MCP servers.
cues.zh: 遠端 MCP 伺服器與本機 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: In our case, we are going to show a remote MCP server because I think they are the future, and local MCPs are for
cues.zh: 這裡會示範遠端 MCP，因為我認為這是未來的方向；本機 MCP 一般比較適合

cues.en: niche areas in general.
cues.zh: 特定的使用情境。

cues.en: Beyond that, I'm not going to go into what MCP is in general unless you report back that you want a dedicated video on
cues.zh: 這裡先不深入 MCP 協定本身，除非大家回饋希望有專門影片，

cues.en: it.
cues.zh: 我再另外介紹。

cues.en: But just see it as someone who has written some code that you would not have had access to.
cues.zh: 先把它想成：其他人寫好了你原本無法直接使用的程式碼，現在可以拿來用。

cues.en: So what we can see here is I have put in one more NuGet package, and that NuGet package is the modelcontextprotocol.
cues.zh: 這裡新增了一個 NuGet 套件，名叫 ModelContextProtocol。

cues.en: Once we have that, we can do something like this.
cues.zh: 安裝之後，就可以這樣寫：

cues.en: Await MCP client.create a new client.
cues.zh: await McpClient.CreateAsync，建立新的用戶端。

cues.en: We want an HTTP client with the options of the endpoint being the Microsoft Learn MCP
cues.zh: 使用 HTTP 傳輸方式，選項裡的端點指定 Microsoft Learn MCP，

cues.en: and its streamable HTTP.
cues.zh: 並採用 Streamable HTTP。

cues.en: So here we can choose between some older models, and up here we can choose between
cues.zh: 這裡也能選一些舊的傳輸模式，上方則可以選擇

cues.en: HTTP and STDIO, which is the local.
cues.zh: HTTP，或本機使用的 STDIO。

cues.en: MCP clients come back, and you need to expose them, so I'm doing an await using here.
cues.zh: 取得 MCP 用戶端後，需要妥善釋放，所以這裡使用 await using。

cues.en: But what we can do is we set a breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 在這裡設個中斷點，

cues.en: We can see that whenever we have an MCP server, we can get what tools it has.
cues.zh: 就能看到 MCP 伺服器提供哪些工具。

cues.en: So just like we've written some tools, Microsoft Learn have written some tools and exposed it to this URL.
cues.zh: 就像我們自己寫工具，Microsoft Learn 也寫好工具，再透過這個網址公開。

cues.en: That's all there is to MCP, to be honest.
cues.zh: 老實說，MCP 的基本概念就是這樣。

cues.en: So if we run it here and get the tools, we can see they have three tools.
cues.zh: 執行並讀取工具清單，可以看到他們提供三個工具。

cues.en: They have a tool for doc search, meaning searching the entire Microsoft Learn site, a tool for finding code samples, and a tool for
cues.zh: 分別是搜尋整個 Microsoft Learn 網站的文件搜尋、尋找程式碼範例，以及

cues.en: fetching a specific Learn site.
cues.zh: 擷取特定 Learn 網頁。

cues.en: Right now, I have not given the tools.
cues.zh: 目前我還沒把工具提供給代理程式。

cues.en: You can see I've commented them out here on purpose.
cues.zh: 可以看到這裡刻意先註解掉。

cues.en: That is to show what we can do with the tools and without the tools.
cues.zh: 因為想比較有工具和沒工具的差異。

cues.en: So I am here, and if I go in and ask the question, make a – oh, I didn't show that.
cues.zh: 假設在這裡問它做一個範例；對了，我還沒展示指示。

cues.en: The instructions here are you are an expert in the C-Sharp version of Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 這裡的指示是：「你是 C# 版本 Microsoft Agent Framework 的專家。」

cues.en: Use tools to find your knowledge, and assume Azure OpenAI with API key is used.
cues.zh: 「使用工具查找知識，並假設使用 Azure OpenAI 與 API 金鑰。」

cues.en: So a little like we do up here.
cues.zh: 也就是和前面的設定類似。

cues.en: And if we ask that without – we just add to LLM, which, by the way, is 4.1 nano.
cues.zh: 如果不提供工具，直接問 LLM；順帶一提，這裡使用 4.1 nano，

cues.en: That was released about one and a half years before Microsoft Agent Framework came along.
cues.zh: 它發布的時間比 Microsoft Agent Framework 早約一年半，

cues.en: It will not know anything about what this is.
cues.zh: 所以完全不知道這個框架是什麼。

cues.en: But if we say make an example on how to make an agent, it will not say I do not know.
cues.zh: 但問它「示範如何建立代理程式」，它不會回答不知道，

cues.en: It will come back and say it's this made-up nonsense.
cues.zh: 而是會回傳這些編造的內容。

cues.en: So it wants to use Windows Forms.
cues.zh: 它想使用 Windows Forms，

cues.en: It wants to use Newtonsoft.
cues.zh: 還想使用 Newtonsoft，

cues.en: It do something with OpenAI here, and then it does all kinds of things that doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 這裡搭配一些 OpenAI 程式碼，再做一堆根本不存在的操作。

cues.en: It has just made stuff up trying to go to OpenAI.
cues.zh: 它只是為了連上 OpenAI，自己拼湊出內容。

cues.en: I have also seen it make some agent packages and so on.
cues.zh: 我也看過它編出一些不存在的代理程式套件。

cues.en: So if we start it again and try to ask the same question, it will come up with something new.
cues.zh: 重新執行，再問相同問題，它又會給另一套答案。

cues.en: Let me ask the same question again.
cues.zh: 再問一次相同的問題。

cues.en: So now it wants to use some COM import in order to make an AI agent trooper.
cues.zh: 這次它想用 COM Import 建立所謂的 AI Agent Trooper。

cues.en: This probably doesn't exist in the world, or if it does, it's certainly not what we want.
cues.zh: 這東西可能根本不存在，就算存在，也肯定不是我們要的。

cues.en: So this is Hallucination's big style because it's in an area it doesn't know anything about.
cues.zh: 因為完全不熟悉這個領域，所以出現非常嚴重的幻覺。

cues.en: But if we give to the tool, which is essentially give it access to the entire
cues.zh: 但如果提供工具，也就是讓它能存取整個

cues.en: Microsoft Learn portal, which of course also have Microsoft agent framework, among other things, it will
cues.zh: Microsoft Learn 入口網站，裡面當然包含 Microsoft Agent Framework 等文件，它就會

cues.en: become much better at this.
cues.zh: 表現得好很多。

cues.en: Not perfect, but much better.
cues.zh: 不是完美，但會好很多。

cues.en: So if we ask the same, make an example on how to make an agent.
cues.zh: 再問一次：「示範如何建立代理程式。」

cues.en: Let me make it big so we can see it better.
cues.zh: 把畫面放大一點，方便看清楚。

cues.en: It will now call the tool and look at the code and so on, and now it suddenly knows Microsoft agent framework.
cues.zh: 它現在會呼叫工具、查看程式碼等等，突然就知道 Microsoft Agent Framework 的用法了。

cues.en: So it now knows it needs to use Azure OpenAI and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 現在也知道要使用 Azure OpenAI 等元件。

cues.en: It gets it from environment variables.
cues.zh: 它從環境變數讀取設定，

cues.en: We did it a bit different.
cues.zh: 和我們剛才的做法有點不同。

cues.en: And it's using not the API key, but now we can actually use it as a teaching experiment on how you instead use the
cues.zh: 它沒有使用 API 金鑰，但剛好可以把這當作教學，看看如何改用

cues.en: role-based access control for Azure by simply just giving up the default.
cues.zh: Azure 的角色型存取控制，也就是傳入 DefaultAzureCredential。

cues.en: And the reason for this is that all the Microsoft samples use this, and they don't actually give a sample on how to get
cues.zh: 原因是微軟的範例都採用這個做法，沒有提供

cues.en: it with an API key because they don't want to have API keys rolling around in their samples.
cues.zh: API 金鑰的版本，因為不希望範例到處流傳 API 金鑰。

cues.en: But beyond that, it gets an Azure client.
cues.zh: 除此之外，它會建立 Azure 用戶端，

cues.en: It turns it into a chat client, and it says create agent, uses instructions and names, and do exactly as we have learned over
cues.zh: 轉成 ChatClient，呼叫 CreateAIAgent，設定指示和名稱，和我們過去幾堂課學到的

cues.en: the last few lectures.
cues.zh: 操作完全相同。

cues.en: And then it gives links to where we can find information about this further on into the system.
cues.zh: 最後還附上連結，讓我們能進一步查閱相關資訊。

cues.en: So that is the power of MCP, that we can, with just these few lines of code, have the entire system.
cues.zh: 這就是 MCP 的力量，只需要這幾行程式碼，就能使用完整的功能。

cues.en: Had Microsoft learned, had an API, we could have probably have built a lot of code and exposed that as a tool, but we don't need to because of MCP.
cues.zh: 假設 Microsoft Learn 只有一般 API，我們也許得寫很多程式，再包裝成工具；有了 MCP，就不需要了。

cues.en: GitHub in the same manner, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: GitHub 等服務也是一樣。

cues.en: MCP can do much, much more.
cues.zh: MCP 還能做更多事情。

cues.en: Again, there's local tools for controlling browsers and stuff like that, but it's a bit beyond the scope of this introduction video at least.
cues.zh: 例如本機工具可以控制瀏覽器等等，不過至少在這段入門影片裡，超出了介紹範圍。

cues.en: But all we do is we make our tools, and conveniently, those tools can be cast into those AI tools that we need down here.
cues.zh: 我們只要取得工具，而且很方便的是，這些工具能直接轉成下面需要的 AITool。

cues.en: So very, very easy to do.
cues.zh: 所以使用起來非常簡單。

cues.en: One thing that are difficult to do right now is authentication against MCP servers.
cues.zh: 目前比較困難的地方，是對 MCP 伺服器進行身分驗證。

cues.en: It's easy to do with API keys and stuff like that, but the entire OAuth part of it is very, very brand new in
cues.zh: API 金鑰等方式很容易，但整個 OAuth 支援在這個

cues.en: this package, so many of the OAuth options don't work as of this recording.
cues.zh: 套件裡還很新，錄製時有不少 OAuth 選項尚未正常運作。

cues.en: But these open and free ones are very easy to use, as you can see.
cues.zh: 不過像這種公開、免費的伺服器，可以看到使用方式非常簡單。
